description: reboot command actually resets the machine (M6.5). Typing `reboot` in the kernel terminal calls crate::power::reboot(), which pulses the 0xCF9 reset-control register and the i8042 CPU reset line; with QEMU's -no-reboot the reset exits QEMU during the settle window so the FAILED marker never prints. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --markers-file tools/m6_reboot_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 30 --timeout 180 --boot-timeout 120 (reuses the ISO from the poweroff run — no --build).

required.claim: the reboot command reached the power mechanism

forbidden.why: the machine did not actually reset — no reset line was honoured
